title: Digital Marketing for Small Businesses in Israel | PinkLime

facts.fact: Smartphone penetration in Israel exceeds 90 percent, according to the PinkLime article.
The Israeli market is described as having nine million people.
facts.quote: A market of nine million people, split between Hebrew and Arabic speakers with significant English fluency.

facts.fact: The article says Israeli internet users spend an average of over three hours daily on their phones.
facts.quote: Israeli internet users spend an average of over three hours daily on their phones

facts.fact: The article states Google has over 95 percent market share in Israeli search.
facts.quote: Google dominates search in Israel with over 95 percent market share
